shots.description: Jax drives the fare's yellow car east through downtown at noon, three Solmar PD cruisers closing in behind, wanted stars lit and the minimap showing the marina drop-off.
shots.label: Three-star chase on the First Fare, noon

shots.description: Jax on foot at the Old Town fountain square at dawn, pedestrians on the sidewalks, the fountain shimmering and the whole city open before the first job.
shots.label: On foot at the Old Town fountain square, morning

shots.description: Jax cracks the Solmar Tower rooftop safe at the downtown plaza under the gold SOLMAR sign at dusk, two stars on the tail and the waypoint beacon marking the getaway.
shots.label: The Tower Job at the downtown plaza, dusk

shots.description: Jax flees north through the night at four stars, headlights on and four PD cruisers in pursuit, the safehouse beacon waiting in the north-west.
shots.label: Bay Getaway at night, four stars
